## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behaviour or documentation change.

## Evidence and decisions

Link the requirement or decision. For data changes, identify the provider, product, model/domain, fields and source documentation. Keep proposed choices distinct from confirmed requirements.

## Validation

Record the checks actually run and their results. Include relevant missing-data, validity, time, unit and height-reference cases for application changes.

## Remaining limitations

List only material unresolved dependencies, access restrictions or verification gaps.
